cards.back: A part of a whole, or of a group, shared equally.
cards.say: Fraction. A part of a whole, or of a group, shared equally.
Half. One of two equal parts. Written one over two.
Quarter. One of four equal parts. Written one over four.
Third. One of three equal parts. Written one over three.

cards.front: What fraction of the circle is shaded?
cards.say: What fraction of the circle is shaded? One half. One of two equal parts.

figure.alt: A circle cut into two equal parts with one part shaded.

cards.front: What fraction of the bar is shaded?
cards.say: What fraction of the bar is shaded? One third. One of three equal parts.

figure.alt: A bar cut into three equal parts with one part shaded.

cards.front: What fraction of the square is shaded?
cards.say: What fraction of the square is shaded? Three quarters. Three of four equal parts.

figure.alt: A square cut into four equal parts with three parts shaded.

cards.front: Which part of the circle is shaded?
cards.say: Which part of the circle is shaded? One quarter. One of four equal parts.

figure.alt: A circle cut into four equal parts with one part shaded.

cards.front: How many quarters make a whole?
cards.say: How many quarters make a whole? Four quarters.

cards.front: How many thirds make a whole?
cards.say: How many thirds make a whole? Three thirds.

cards.front: How many quarters are in a half?
cards.say: How many quarters are in a half? Two quarters.
Three quarters. Three of four equal parts. Written three over four.

cards.back: Parts that are exactly the same size. Fractions need equal parts.
cards.say: Equal parts. Parts that are exactly the same size. Fractions need equal parts.
Half of eight. Four. Eight divided by two equals four.
Half of twelve. Six. Twelve divided by two equals six.
Half of twenty. Ten. Twenty divided by two equals ten.
Half of forty. Twenty. Forty divided by two equals twenty.
A quarter of eight. Two. Eight divided by four equals two.
A quarter of twelve. Three. Twelve divided by four equals three.
A quarter of twenty. Five. Twenty divided by four equals five.
A quarter of forty. Ten. Forty divided by four equals ten.
A third of six. Two. Six divided by three equals two.
A third of twelve. Four. Twelve divided by three equals four.
A third of thirty. Ten. Thirty divided by three equals ten.

cards.back: 6. A quarter of 8 is 2, so 3 quarters is 3 × 2 = 6.
cards.say: Three quarters of eight. Six. A quarter of eight is two, so three quarters is three times two equals six.

cards.back: 9. A quarter of 12 is 3, so 3 quarters is 9.
cards.say: Three quarters of twelve. Nine. A quarter of twelve is three, so three quarters is nine.

cards.front: Which is bigger: a half or a quarter?
cards.back: A half. It is made of 2 quarters.
cards.say: Which is bigger: a half or a quarter? A half. It is made of two quarters.

cards.front: Which is bigger: a third or a quarter of the same cake?
cards.back: A third. Sharing into 3 gives bigger pieces than sharing into 4.
cards.say: Which is bigger: a third or a quarter of the same cake? A third. Sharing into three gives bigger pieces than sharing into four.
